courses.title: Java Full Stack Developer Certification Program
courses.description: Launch your career as a Java Full-Stack developer. Master core Java, J2EE, Spring Boot, microservice architectures, Hibernate, and modern React.js frontend structures. Learn database design with MySQL/PostgreSQL, robust JWT authorization, and Docker deployments.

courses.title: Data Analyst & Business Intelligence Masterclass
courses.description: Equip yourself with the tools to solve complex business problems. Master Advanced Excel, SQL Databases, Python script analysis, and build professional interactive analytics dashboards in Power BI & Tableau. Practice on real-world financial and product data.

courses.title: Python Full Stack Training Program
courses.description: Build robust dynamic web applications using Python. Learn Python programming fundamentals, Django MVC architectural frameworks, FastAPI restful APIs, HTML5/CSS3, Tailwind CSS styling, JavaScript, and PostgreSQL storage architectures.

courses.title: Oracle SQL & Relational Database Training
courses.description: Deep-dive into enterprise relational databases. Master Oracle SQL writing, complex multi-table JOINs, subqueries, analytical window functions, PL/SQL trigger programming, stored procedures, indexes, and database query optimization.

courses.title: Automation Testing Masterclass: Selenium & Cucumber
courses.description: Master automated software verification. Learn Selenium WebDriver SDK, core Java testing patterns, TestNG runner configuration, Cucumber BBD Gherkin syntax, page object designs (POM), CI/CD pipelines, and Maven project building.

courses.title: Modern React 19 & Frontend Architecture Masterclass
courses.description: Master React 19 from the ground up. Deep-dive into Concurrent Mode, the React Compiler, custom hooks, context isolation, state-management architectures, Server Components, Server Actions, Suspense APIs, and CSS Tailwind design layouts.

courses.title: React Tested - Enterprise Testing & Architecture
courses.description: Step-by-step masterclass on testing modern React 19 web applications. Learn component testing, integration tests, mock endpoints, and dynamic performance validation using Jest, Cypress, and modern React Testing Library.

modules.title: Java Foundations & OOP Principles
modules.description: Core JDK architecture, syntax, object-oriented concepts, exception mechanisms, and collection frameworks.

modules.title: Backend Services with Spring Boot & Hibernate
modules.description: Building production REST APIs, Spring Data JPA mappings, security filters, and JWT authorization.

modules.title: Frontend Integration with React & Deployment
modules.description: Consuming REST APIs, state handlers, building dynamic UI layouts, and containerizing with Docker.

modules.title: Advanced Excel & Data Cleaning Systems
modules.description: Automating workflows with pivot tables, index/match lookups, Power Query pipelines, and error isolation.

modules.title: SQL queries & Power BI Analytics Dashboards
modules.description: Formulating PostgreSQL statements, connecting datasets in Power BI Desktop, DAX metrics, and dashboard reports.

modules.title: Python Essentials & Django REST API foundations
modules.description: Python data structures, decorators, Django models, MVC setup, and REST API serialization.

modules.title: Oracle SQL syntax & Relational schema setups
modules.description: DDL/DML instructions, normalization keys, set operators, and subquery definitions.

modules.title: Selenium Framework Setup & BDD Gherkin integration
modules.description: WebDriver locators, wait configurations, Cucumber features, and JUnit reports.

modules.title: Chapter 1: Concurrent Rendering & React 19 Hooks
modules.description: Deep-dive into concurrent loops, Suspense boundary states, asset loading, Actions API, and the brand-new compiler.

modules.title: Chapter 1: Component Rendering & Unit Tests
modules.description: Explore Jest and React Testing Library setup, rendering states, and user interactions testing.

skillfort_qa_threads_course-2.title: Recommendation on external playground environments?
skillfort_qa_threads_course-2.text: Hi support and classmates, do we need to install PostgreSQL locally for the database normalization lab, or is the browser client terminal sufficient?

replies.text: You can absolutely use our browser terminal sandbox! All configurations are pre-wired. Installing pgAdmin locally is optional but useful for backup.

skillfort_qa_threads_course-2.title: Stuck on the week 2 quiz assessment
skillfort_qa_threads_course-2.text: Are we going to receive retry credits if we miss the passing mark code of 80% on standard assessments? Please advise on placement rules.

replies.text: Yes Karthik! Students can re-attempt quizzes as many times as needed to reinforce concepts before placement alignment audits.
